spec.kitLine: Activates when the last bullet hits
spec.assertion: With the heal target widened to all allies (so the recovery consumer is guaranteed reached), the shipped trigger produces exactly the same buffApply count as a forced lastBullet trigger, while a forced shotFired trigger produces strictly more (~9x, magazine = 9). Fails under the nearest-wrong shotFired/hitCount/interval keying, and fails vacuously-safe if the heal is missing (the strict shotFired>lastBullet guard goes red).

Shipped recovery-event count is bounded below by the heal-deleted run and above by the all-allies widening. Fails under an 'all allies' mis-scope only when the widening strictly exceeds the shipped scope; the ceiling nonetheless forbids over-crediting the target set. (alliesLowestHp is the documented leftmost-N stand-in — v1 has no HP pool.)

spec.kitLine: Recovers 8.4% of user's final Max HP
spec.assertion: No mary-cast buffApply carries value 8.4 — proves the HP magnitude was not smuggled into a stat modifier. The amount itself is unobservable (no HP pool; the `heal` effect has no amount field), so only the recovery event is testable.

it.skip — the payload it would carry (incoming healing) has no StatKey, so the trigger has nothing observable to fire. Trigger identity is fullBurstEnter (any team Full Burst), NOT burstCast; recorded for the override's unmodeled.skill2.

LIVE guard: no mary-cast buffApply carries value 23.78. Fails under the nearest-wrong 'keep the line by encoding it as some existing stat' (e.g. maxHpPct / attackDamagePct), which would invent a damage-relevant mechanic the kit does not grant.

Deleting the burst heal strictly reduces total buffApply events (the recovery consumer sits in 'all allies', so it is always reached). Fails under heal-dropped or heal-scoped-to-self/one-ally. The 39.6% magnitude is UNMODELED (it.skip).

Scope-trivially true (no HP pool; nothing takes damage at scope lock), so the DEF grant must re-fire on every cast: ≥2 distinct expiresFrame values among the defPct 19.8 applications. Fails under a once-per-battle model or a gate that suppresses the line.

Paired counterfactual: deleting the defPct buff leaves every slug's totals byte-identical (defPct is v1-inert), while re-stating the same 19.8 as atkPct moves the board. The pair proves the buff is KEPT for kit completeness AND that it is not mis-encoded into a damage-moving stat. Target-set: distinct targetSlugs == comp size, so it is allies-including-self (fails under excludeSelf or self-only).

spec.kitLine: (no damage line anywhere in the kit)
spec.assertion: No damage event from mary's slot carries bucket 'skill' or 'burst', and no mary-cast buffApply carries any offensive StatKey. Fails under any invented flatDamage/dot/hitRepeat rider or an offensive buff added to make a supporter 'contribute'.

fixtures: controlComp('mary', true) for all 8 hoisted runs (deterministic, no seed). Chosen because the fixed B1/B2 slots are what make bursts cast at all, and because crown in the control comp is the ONLY observable channel for mary's heals: SimEvent has no heal/recovery kind, so an unobservable heal effect becomes measurable via crown's `recovery` trigger emitting buffApply events. Helm kept ON (fixed-B3 flag true) so Full Bursts occur reliably; helm's buffs cannot confound the mary-scoped filters because every mary assertion is keyed on casterIdx (read off the defPct 19.8 application) or on a delta between two runs that differ ONLY in mary's override. RISK DECLARED: mary is Burst I and the control comp's liter is a same-stage competitor, so her own burst may never cast — the first test is an explicit non-vacuity guard for exactly that, and the defToAtk board-movement test cross-checks it (both red together = fixture finding, not an override finding).
gaps: it.skip skill2 'Incoming healing 23.78% for 15 sec' — no incoming-healing StatKey exists and heals carry no HP amount, so there is no consumer and no observable payload (belongs in unmodeled.skill2). A live guard still asserts it was not encoded as a different stat.
it.skip burst 'Recovers 39.6% of the skill user's final Max HP' — v1 models no HP pool and the `heal` effect has no amount field; only the recovery EVENT is testable (asserted separately).
S1's 8.4% heal magnitude — same reason; only the negative guard (no stat carries 8.4) is testable.
'Affects 1 ally with the lowest HP percentage' — v1 has no HP pool, so lowest-HP% resolves to the documented leftmost-N stand-in; the exact recipient is untestable, only the bounded scope is.
'Activates when above 50% HP' — no HP pool, so the gate is scope-trivially always true; the test asserts it never suppresses a cast rather than proving the gate itself.

10 sec / 15 sec durations — buffApply exposes expiresFrame but the events carry no apply-frame field to difference against, so the window LENGTH is not asserted (only that distinct windows recur across casts).

defPct damage effect — inert in v1 by engine design (self DEF does not affect own damage), so the DEF line's in-game value is unobservable; the test asserts kit-completeness retention + inertness only.
